title: [BUG] New+ menu hasn't been working on Win11 with classic context menu enabled for several versions (Currently not working in v0.99.1)

judgment.rationale: The issue's classic Windows 11 context-menu symptom is directly covered by the more detailed open tracker #48512. The original reporter now says formatting Windows 11 resolved their instance, while a later commenter reports a related Nilesoft Shell case; neither supports starting a separate PowerToys fix workflow from this issue.
evidence: The issue body reports that New+ is missing from the Windows 11 classic context menu when the classic menu is enabled.
The original reporter said on 2026-09-04 that formatting Windows 11 resolved the original instance.
Issue #48512 is an open New+ tracker for the same Windows 11 classic-context-menu behavior and includes registration, handler-loading, and runtime evidence.
Issue #48512 documents that the current classic handler is loaded but produces no visible entry, and that restoring the modern menu makes New+ appear.
Current PowerToys main still has an explicit Windows 11 rejection in NewShellExtensionContextMenu.win10/shell_context_menu_win10.cpp::QueryContextMenu.
The recent history for that handler includes the runtime shell-extension registration refactor in PR #41275.
judgment.recommended_action: Close or mark this report as covered by issue #48512 and direct any still-reproducible classic-menu or Nilesoft-specific evidence to that canonical tracker.

fix_assessment.rationale: A separate fix plan would duplicate the active investigation in issue #48512. This issue is suitable for deduplication rather than an independent implementation design.

issue_context.summary: New+ was reported missing from the Windows 11 classic context menu, but the reporter later said their instance was resolved by formatting Windows 11. A later commenter still reports a related failure with Nilesoft Shell.
known_information: The issue is open, unassigned, and labeled Issue-Bug, Needs-Triage, and Product-New+.
The original report targets PowerToys 0.99.1 and describes enabling the Windows 11 classic context menu before checking the desktop or folder background menu.
The original reporter supplied a PowerToys bug-report ZIP attachment.
The original reporter stated that formatting Windows 11 resolved the original problem.
A later commenter said New+ also did not appear with Nilesoft Shell.
Issue #48512 is open and describes the same classic-menu compatibility problem with more detailed public diagnostics.
Current main's classic New+ handler returns E_FAIL when New+ is disabled or Windows 11 is detected.
The handler's recent history includes the runtime registration migration associated with PR #41275.
inferences: The original failure may have been caused by machine-specific shell registration or environment state rather than a currently isolated reproducible defect in this report.

The Nilesoft Shell comment may represent the same underlying classic-handler limitation, but it is not enough to establish that Nilesoft is PowerToys-supported or that the two environments fail for the same reason.
Issue #48512 is the appropriate place to consolidate investigation of the Windows 11 classic-handler rejection and registration behavior.
issue_context.analysis: The public evidence supports deduplication: #48512 has the same user-visible behavior, an explicit classic-menu reproduction, and concrete handler/registration observations. The new comments reduce confidence that #47609 still represents an independently reproducible bug, because the reporter says the original instance was resolved. The Nilesoft report should be preserved as context for the canonical tracker rather than used to create competing fix work.
initial_investigation: Compared the full body and latest comments of #47609 with open issue #48512; the reproduction and expected behavior overlap directly.
Read the current public New+ classic handler source. QueryContextMenu returns E_FAIL on Windows 11 before adding New+ menu items.
Read the current public Win10 registration specification, which registers the classic handler under the Directory Background ShellEx ContextMenuHandlers key.
Checked recent New+ history; the classic handler was affected by the runtime shell-extension registration refactor described in PR #41275.
Searched related public issues and found no more specific open duplicate than #48512.

actions.label: Link the canonical New+ classic-menu issue
actions.note: Maintainer-facing duplicate/handled comment; no upstream comment has been posted.

comment.body: Thanks for the detailed report. This behavior is already tracked in the more detailed New+ classic-context-menu issue: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/issues/48512. That issue covers the same Windows 11 classic-menu path and includes the relevant registration and handler diagnostics. Since you also reported that formatting Windows 11 resolved your original instance, please add any still-reproducible classic-menu or Nilesoft Shell details to #48512 so the investigation stays consolidated.
